name: Archive change back to OpenSpec on merge (designed; wired at M1)
description: The 'back to OpenSpec' loop-closer. When a delivered change's PR merges, the run routes archive_change, which shells `openspec archive` via the archive harness and stamps openspec.change.archived — the step that keeps the target repo's specs truthful (G10). At M0 this rule is DECLARED but DISABLED: the merge-event trigger (a forge-io PR-merged fact) and the live archive call land at M1, and the M0 mock journey terminates at open_pr (delivery.pr.ref). Enabling this rule is an M1 task; its merge-trigger predicate is introduced by that change (G9). openspec.change.archived's single writer is the archive harness (G5).

metadata.note: merge-event trigger + live openspec archive land at M1
